title: Brooks Falls bear cam
about: Brown bears gather at a waterfall in Katmai National Park to catch salmon swimming upstream. Busiest from midsummer into autumn.

title: Okaukuejo waterhole cam
about: A waterhole in Etosha National Park where animals come to drink, day and night. Worth checking at dusk.

title: Panama fruit feeder cam
about: A fruit feeder at Canopy Lodge in the hills of Panama that draws tanagers, toucans and other tropical birds.

title: Tembe elephant cam
about: A camera in Tembe Elephant Park, run with Africam, watching a spot where elephants and other animals pass through.

title: Cornell FeederWatch cam
about: Bird feeders in the garden at Sapsucker Woods, home of the Cornell Lab of Ornithology. Busiest in the morning.

title: Royal albatross cam
about: A northern royal albatross nest at a colony in New Zealand, streamed with the New Zealand Department of Conservation.

title: Namib Desert cam
about: A live view of the Namib, one of the oldest deserts in the world.

title: Decorah eagles, north nest
about: A bald eagle nest in northeast Iowa. Nest cams are seasonal: expect eggs and chicks in spring, and a quiet nest at other times.

title: Panama hummingbird cam
about: Hummingbird feeders at Canopy Tower in Panama, visited by several tropical hummingbird species.

title: Kalahari cam
about: A live view of the Kalahari, the dry savanna that stretches across eastern Namibia.

title: Ontario FeederWatch cam
about: Feeders in the boreal forest of northern Ontario. Winter is the best time, when northern finches and jays visit.

title: Cornell red-tailed hawks
about: A red-tailed hawk nest high above the Cornell University campus. Most active in spring, when the pair raises chicks.

title: Hellgate osprey nest
about: An osprey nest in western Montana, streamed with the University of Montana. Ospreys migrate, so the nest is busiest from spring to late summer.
